GOVERNMENT NOTICE No. 272 Published On. 19/3/2021
THE FOREST ACT,
(CAP. 323)
______
ORDER
______
(Made under section 22(1))
THE FOREST (IRANGI SCARP FOREST RESERVE) (DECLARATION) ORDER, 2021
Citation
1. This Order may be cited as the Forest (Irangi
Scarp Forest Reserve) (Declaration) Order, 2021.
Declaration
2. The area of general land within the limits and
boundaries defined in the Schedule to this Order is hereby
declared as Irangi Scarp Forest Reserve.
GN. NO. 272 (Contd.)
__________
SCHEDULE
___________
(Made under paragraph 2)
KONDOA DISTRICT
IRANGI SCARP FOREST RESERVE
Approximate area: 13762.57 Hectares or 137.62 Square Kilometres
Situation and Boundaries
All that area of general land formerly under Irangi Scarp Forest situated in Kondoa district,
Dodoma region as delineated on survey division Map No. Jb 2934 of 2019 (Scale 1:50000)
deposited with the Director of Surveys and Mapping Division of the Ministry of Lands, Housing
and Human Settlement Development, Dodoma and bounded as follows:
